properties.name: Luxury House & Lot - Ladislawa, Davao City
properties.summary: A spacious luxury residence in Ladislawa with generous indoor living spaces, private family areas, and premium support rooms for comfortable upscale living.
description: This luxury house and lot in Ladislawa offers an expansive residential layout for families who need both comfort and functionality. The second floor includes 3 bedrooms, 3 toilet and bath areas, a master bedroom with walk-in closet, a private bathroom with bathtub, and a family area with open balcony.

On the ground floor, the property features a guest room with its own CR, a library room, powder room, spacious living area, dining area, kitchen area, pantry, and a maid's room with its own CR. Additional improvements include a driver's room outside, a 2-car carport, and a gazebo with powder room.
features: Master bedroom with walk-in closet and bathtub
Spacious living, dining, kitchen, and pantry

properties.name: Newly Built House - Ilumina Buhangin, Davao City
properties.summary: A newly built modern home in Ilumina, Buhangin featuring 5 bedrooms, custom storage, inverter air-conditioning, and smart utility provisions.
description: This brand-new home in Ilumina, Buhangin is ready for occupancy and built for buyers who want modern finishes with practical daily-use features. The layout includes 5 bedrooms, 4 toilet and bath areas with multipoint heater, a 2-car garage, and 1 stock room.

Interior highlights include modular kitchen cabinets with under-cabinet lighting, a kitchen island with drawers, moisture-resistant room cabinets, designed lighting setup, and a laundry area with washing machine provision. Utilities and extras include a water tank, anti-termite pipe provision, and an easy-access plumbing layout.
features: 4 toilet and bath with multipoint heater
Modular kitchen cabinets with under-cabinet lighting
Laundry area with washing machine provision

properties.name: Multi-House Property - Juna Subdivision, Matina
properties.summary: A multi-unit property in Juna Subdivision with a main house, second unit, and back house, positioned near SM Ecoland and key commercial areas.
description: This multi-house property in Juna Subdivision is ideal for buyers seeking a flexible residential compound, multi-family setup, or investment property. The main house includes 3 bedrooms, a master bedroom with its own bathroom, 2 bedrooms with shared CR, a living area, and an indoor kitchen.

The second unit has an auxiliary kitchen and its own bathroom, while the back house includes 2 bedrooms, a shared kitchen, and an external CR. Additional features include a 2 to 3 car garage, laundry area, walking distance to SM Ecoland and nearby commercial establishments, and easy access to the main road.
features: Second unit with auxiliary kitchen and own bathroom
Shared kitchen and external CR in back house
Near commercial establishments and main road

properties.name: Brand New Bungalow - Santiago Villas, Catalunan Grande
properties.location: Santiago Villas, Catalunan Grande, Davao City
properties.summary: A brand-new bungalow on a corner lot inside a gated and guarded community with easy downtown access and financing options available.
description: This ready-for-occupancy bungalow in Santiago Villas, Catalunan Grande is suited for buyers looking for an affordable and practical family home inside a secure subdivision. The layout includes 3 bedrooms, 2 toilet and bath areas, and a covered car garage.

The property sits on a corner lot within a gated and guarded subdivision in a flood-free high-elevation area. It offers an accessible location with one ride to downtown, and payment can be arranged through spot cash or bank financing.

properties.name: Samal View Estate Lot
properties.summary: A premium residential lot in a fast-appreciating area with city access and excellent long-term investment appeal.
description: Samal View Estate Lot is positioned for buyers who want to secure land in a strategic location before further area appreciation. The property works well for future residential development or land banking.
Its location gives convenient access to transport routes while maintaining a neighborhood character suitable for upscale home construction.

properties.name: Mintal Corner Commercial Lot
properties.summary: A corner lot suited for mixed-use development, showroom space, or a future rental-income property.
description: Mintal Corner Commercial Lot offers strong road visibility and flexibility for business or mixed-use planning. Its corner positioning improves access, frontage, and future development options.
For investors looking at long-term commercial potential, this lot gives a solid entry point in a growing district with active local demand.

properties.name: Elev8 Furnished Condo
properties.summary: A furnished condo unit for professionals and small families who want a central address and flexible move-in setup.
description: Elev8 Furnished Condo is ready for immediate occupancy, with basic furnishing already in place for a smoother move-in process. It suits tenants who want convenience near offices, malls, and dining areas.
The unit layout is efficient and bright, making it a practical choice for long-term city living or executive accommodation.

properties.name: Lanang Family Townhouse Rental
properties.summary: A spacious townhouse rental with multiple rooms, ideal for families who want comfort and access to key business districts.
description: Lanang Family Townhouse Rental offers more space than a condo, making it a strong fit for families or company housing requirements. It includes flexible living areas and a functional kitchen setup.
Its Lanang location provides quick access to commercial centers, schools, and major transport routes while preserving residential privacy.

properties.name: Buhangin Modern Build Package
properties.summary: A modern residential design-and-build package for clients who already own land and want a guided construction process.
description: Buhangin Modern Build Package is built for landowners who want a clearer path from concept to turnover. The package can include design consultation, budgeting, construction coordination, and finishing guidance.
This setup helps clients move faster while keeping design quality and build planning aligned with their target budget and lot conditions.

properties.name: Selene Model - Premium Mediterranean Residence at Villa Conchita
properties.location: Villa Conchita, Bago Gallera, Davao City
properties.summary: Own a premium 2-storey Mediterranean-inspired home in Villa Conchita, a prestigious 27-hectare gated community in Bago Gallera, Davao City. Featuring spacious living areas, 4 bedrooms, and family-oriented amenities, the Selene Model offers the perfect balance of comfort, security, and modern living.
description: Discover elevated living with the Selene Model at Villa Conchita, a beautifully designed 2-storey Mediterranean-inspired residence located in one of Davao City's most desirable communities. Thoughtfully crafted for growing families, this premium home offers spacious interiors, elegant architectural details, and a lifestyle centered on comfort and exclusivity.

Set within a 27-hectare gated neighborhood in Bago Gallera, the Selene Model provides a secure and peaceful environment while remaining conveniently accessible to essential establishments throughout the city. Its well-planned layout includes four generously sized bedrooms, three bathrooms, and ample living spaces designed to accommodate both daily living and special family gatherings.

Residents of Villa Conchita enjoy access to exceptional community amenities including a swimming pool, basketball court, clubhouse, and open pavilion. Whether you're searching for your family's forever home or a valuable real estate investment, the Selene Model offers outstanding value in a thriving and highly sought-after residential community. Reserve your unit today and secure your place in this exclusive neighborhood.
features: Access to Swimming Pool, Clubhouse, Basketball Court, and Open Pavilion
Pre-selling and Near Ready for Occupancy (RFO) Units Available
Ideal for Family Living and Long-Term Investment

properties.name: Toril Duplex Construction Package
properties.summary: A duplex-focused construction package for investors planning rental income, multi-family use, or phased property development.
description: Toril Duplex Construction Package is structured for clients who want to maximize land use through a two-unit residential concept. It can suit owner-occupiers, extended families, or investors planning rental returns.
The package emphasizes efficient planning, practical unit division, and a build approach that supports future occupancy or leasing goals.
